record.one_liner: Email and SMS marketing platform (audiences, campaigns, automations, reports) with a Marketing API.
record.auth_notes: API key authenticates against own account; OAuth 2 for accounts belonging to others. Basic with token as password is not username+password so basic not listed. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: critic: access confirmed self_serve_free. Free plan exists (250 contacts, 500 sends/month) and the developer docs say to create an API key from the account's API Keys section with no paid-plan or approval gate; no page says API needs a paid tier (pricing page re-fetch failed on network, free plan quote is from search snippet). Keys created from June 22, 2026 expire after 1 year.
record.api_notes: Marketing API endpoints under /developer/marketing/api/... with bearer auth, path and query params; rest inferred from endpoint structure. Breadth not verified against full list.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready confirmed. The official MCP server is a docs-search server only; it does not access the user's account. Account actions go through the API directly. No approval step documented.

evidence.quote: An API key authenticates against the account that created it.
OAuth 2 authenticates against an account belonging to someone else.
An API key authenticates requests against your own Mailchimp account.
Users with Manager permissions can generate their own API keys.
The Free plan includes up to 250 contacts and 500 sends per month, with a daily send limit of 250.
Every request to the Marketing API carries a credential.
This documentation site is itself an MCP server.
This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.
Copy the generated key immediately and store it in a secure location.
